title: Skills and Business
intro: Learn skills, try small projects and start something of your own.

nodes.label: Learn a digital skill
nodes.note: Coding, design, spreadsheets or marketing. Many free courses exist.

nodes.label: Try a small project
nodes.note: Run a school fair stall, sell something small or teach a class. You learn money and teamwork.

nodes.label: Short skill course (certificate)
nodes.note: Weeks to months. Check that the course is approved.

nodes.label: Start-up or college incubator
nodes.note: Get mentors, a space and sometimes small funds.

nodes.label: Freelancer (design, coding, content)
nodes.note: Work for clients on your own time.

nodes.label: Skilled technician
nodes.note: Electrician, solar installer, mobile repair and more.

nodes.label: Start-up founder or shop owner
nodes.note: Build your own business.

nodes.label: Self-employed professional
nodes.note: Tutor, caterer, photographer or repair expert.

nodes.label: Digital marketer
nodes.note: Promote brands online.

nodes.label: Video editor
nodes.note: Cut and polish videos.

nodes.label: Web designer
nodes.note: Build and design websites.

nodes.label: Tutor or trainer
nodes.note: Teach what you know.

nodes.label: Photographer or videographer
nodes.note: Shoot events and brands.

nodes.label: Caterer
nodes.note: Cook for parties and events.

nodes.label: Beauty and wellness professional
nodes.note: Hair, skin and wellness services.

nodes.label: Content creator
nodes.note: Make videos or posts people follow.

nodes.label: Yoga or fitness instructor
nodes.note: Lead yoga and fitness classes.

nodes.label: Office and data assistant
nodes.note: Help with office tasks and data.

nodes.label: Social entrepreneur
nodes.note: Start a business that solves a community problem.

nodes.label: Agri start-up founder
nodes.note: Use new ideas to help farmers.

nodes.label: App or tech founder
nodes.note: Build and sell a software product.
